lines: Settled 98° at 5:07PM, in 98° to 99°. The noon lean was 98° to 99° at 53% — held (forecast 97.6, off by 0.4°).
The market disagreed at noon, on 96° to 97° — we were right. Morning disagreements have favoured the forecast in the record; afternoon ones favour the market.

The high was set at 5:07PM — after the 1:51 PM six-hour group; the hourly reports topped out at 97°, 1° under the settlement — a peak between reports that the 5-minute feed or a corroborated TWC maximum would have seen.
Lesson: the forecast was within 0.4° and the range held; nothing to change.
